title: Search and Learning at a Daily Deals Website
authors: Mantian Mandy Hu; Chu Dang; Pradeep K. Chintagunta
eligible_reason: Dynamic structural model of search and Dirichlet learning at a daily-deals site; reduced-form plm regressions of clicks/purchases on deal quality, price and tenure. No policy adoption or DiD.
design_notes: reduced-form.R: lm/plm of quality, ifClick, ifPur and if_featured on deal attributes, tenure and cumulative clicks. Fortran structural estimation and Monte Carlo. No treatment timing.
data_files_note: 'A sample of the full panel data of new subscribers' (no sampling rule stated); structural code uses synthetic data because of NDA.
data_provenance_note: Small extract with no stated random sampling rule plus synthetic data for the structural model.
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally (data/text and papers/ empty for this suffix); screened from README, code, data and the OpenAlex abstract. Out of scope.
